acs.text_first_line: An agent step gives one entry that names the rule, its version and the applied result
The entry names the agent and model versions of the run, and holds none when no policy is in force
The recommendation carries its confidence and the applied result stays the rule result
A fallback is true with its reason and the run id in the actions
A repeated step key gives one entry and one chain link
A record that cannot be written stops the step and leaves no entry
The entry is readable on the two reads and the chain covers it
The decision code is a list value and the fallback rate is countable from the entries
